names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 15038, «Михаил (Красноцветов), пресвитер, сщмч.», with the rank words left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after his name: «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера (1937)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 29 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера (1937).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 29 septembrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
Not checked: saint.gr/09/29 was not read for him (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for the civil day this Julian 29 September falls on was not read (2026-10-04).
